derivation_policy: Aggregate SFT and frozen-evaluation failures may define abstract behavior classes only. Official prompts, tests, references, model responses, retries, and semantic copies are forbidden from curriculum tasks.

capabilities.rationale: Evaluation showed the weakest correctness around temporal normalization and boundaries.
Malformed-input handling and structured parsing were frequent semantic failures.
State invariants, rollback, ordering, and concurrency were weak.
Algorithms are retained as composed correctness work rather than the dominant lane.
Grid dimensions, coordinates, and exact text logic exposed brittle assumptions.
Numerical anchors detect overflow, signedness, and exactness regressions.

failure_modes.observed_pattern: Ordinary values work while rollover boundaries fail.
failure_modes.abstract_defect: Normalization uses an incorrect inclusive or exclusive boundary.
failure_modes.clean_room_rule: Use unrelated fictional clocks or calendars and test both sides of every boundary.

failure_modes.observed_pattern: Negative offsets produce invalid components or the wrong day.
failure_modes.abstract_defect: Language remainder semantics are mistaken for mathematical modulo.
failure_modes.clean_room_rule: Generate signed offsets around zero and multiple complete periods.

failure_modes.observed_pattern: Common dates work while leap or variable-length periods fail.
failure_modes.abstract_defect: The implementation hardcodes a typical period length.
failure_modes.clean_room_rule: Use a synthetic calendar with independently documented variable periods.

failure_modes.observed_pattern: Simple fields parse but quoting, escaping, or embedded separators fail.
failure_modes.abstract_defect: The parser splits text without tracking grammar state.
failure_modes.clean_room_rule: Define a new compact grammar and test escaped and nested separators.

failure_modes.observed_pattern: Structurally invalid inputs are partially accepted.
failure_modes.abstract_defect: Validation checks only a prefix or a subset of constraints.
failure_modes.clean_room_rule: Pair each valid production with independently malformed variants.

failure_modes.observed_pattern: A rejected operation leaves observable state changed.
failure_modes.abstract_defect: Mutation occurs before all validation succeeds.
failure_modes.clean_room_rule: Snapshot state before invalid operations and require exact rollback.

failure_modes.observed_pattern: Individual operations pass but a sequence violates capacity or uniqueness.
failure_modes.abstract_defect: Local updates do not preserve the global invariant.
failure_modes.clean_room_rule: Exercise generated operation sequences with an independent state model.

failure_modes.observed_pattern: Results vary across runs or violate documented ordering.
failure_modes.abstract_defect: Observable order depends on unstable traversal or scheduling.
failure_modes.clean_room_rule: Repeat identical schedules and compare against an explicit ordering contract.

failure_modes.observed_pattern: Concurrent operations lose updates or expose invalid intermediate state.
failure_modes.abstract_defect: Shared state lacks sufficient synchronization or atomicity.
failure_modes.clean_room_rule: Use bounded deterministic stress plus sanitizer-backed safety evidence.

failure_modes.observed_pattern: Typical inputs work while empty, duplicate, cyclic, or degenerate structures fail.
failure_modes.abstract_defect: The algorithm assumes a regular non-empty structure.
failure_modes.clean_room_rule: Cover structural identities and degeneracies with independent oracles.

failure_modes.observed_pattern: Correct small cases time out at the documented bound.
failure_modes.abstract_defect: The selected algorithm has the wrong asymptotic behavior.
failure_modes.clean_room_rule: Include deterministic large cases with generous but discriminating limits.

failure_modes.observed_pattern: Square examples pass while rectangular layouts fail.
failure_modes.abstract_defect: Rows and columns are swapped or assumed equal.
failure_modes.clean_room_rule: Use asymmetric dimensions and orientation-sensitive expected results.

failure_modes.observed_pattern: Edges are skipped, double-counted, or accessed out of bounds.
failure_modes.abstract_defect: Neighbor and boundary predicates are incomplete.
failure_modes.clean_room_rule: Place independent features at corners, edges, and one-cell dimensions.

failure_modes.observed_pattern: Small positive values work while large or signed values fail.
failure_modes.abstract_defect: Intermediate type width or signedness does not cover the domain.
failure_modes.clean_room_rule: Test extrema and intermediate overflow with an exact wide oracle.

failure_modes.observed_pattern: Out-of-domain digits or parameters are silently incorporated.
failure_modes.abstract_defect: Domain validation is missing before arithmetic.
failure_modes.clean_room_rule: Generate valid and invalid symbols at every position and require exact rejection.

rubrics.desired_behavior: Normalize exactly at and around every documented period boundary.
Produce canonical components for positive and negative multi-period offsets.
Apply all documented variable-period and exceptional-period rules.
Respect quoting, escaping, and complete grammar state.
Reject every structurally or semantically invalid input using the documented API.
Leave all observable state unchanged after a rejected operation.
Preserve capacity, uniqueness, and consistency across operation sequences.
Return the documented order reproducibly across equivalent runs.
Concurrent operations preserve state and remain sanitizer-clean.
Handle empty, duplicate, cyclic, and degenerate structures as documented.
Complete deterministic upper-bound cases within the declared resource envelope.
Preserve row and column semantics on asymmetric rectangular inputs.
Process corners, edges, and one-cell dimensions exactly and safely.
Use exact intermediate arithmetic across the full signed input domain.
Reject invalid numerical symbols and parameters before arithmetic.
